items.exampleEn: You did a terrific job on the report.
My ambitious cousin plans to run her own company one day.
items.exampleZh: 我那位很有抱負的表親打算有一天自己開公司。

items.exampleEn: We gave him a small gift to show our appreciation.
items.exampleZh: 我們送他一份小禮物表達感謝。

items.exampleEn: To our disappointment, the concert was canceled.
items.exampleZh: 令我們失望的是，音樂會取消了。

items.exampleEn: He has been a loyal customer for twenty years.
items.exampleZh: 他二十年來都是忠實顧客。

items.exampleEn: Can you honestly say you enjoyed the movie?
items.exampleZh: 你能老實說你喜歡那部電影嗎？

items.exampleEn: I owe you an apology for being rude yesterday.
items.exampleZh: 昨天我很沒禮貌，欠你一個道歉。

items.exampleEn: Be cautious when you drive in heavy rain.

items.sentenceEn: Honestly, I think we should leave now.
items.sentenceZh: 老實說，我覺得我們現在該走了。

items.audioEn: The manager made an apology to the customers for the long wait.
items.audioZh: 經理因為讓顧客久等而向他們道歉。
options: Because customers waited a long time
Because the manager had to wait

items.sentenceEn: Ambitious people often set high goals for themselves.
items.sentenceZh: 有抱負的人常給自己訂下很高的目標。

items.sentenceEn: The movie was a disappointment, so we left early.
items.sentenceZh: 那部電影令人失望，所以我們提早離開。

items.stemEn: The food here is ____; you must try the fish!
items.stemZh: 這裡的食物棒極了，你一定要嚐嚐魚！

items.stemEn: My grandfather is ____ with money; he never spends it quickly.
items.stemZh: 我爺爺用錢很謹慎，從不亂花。

items.passageEn: Last week, our team leader, Nora, left the company after ten years. She had always been loyal and hard-working. But she was also ambitious, so she took a new job in Singapore. Many of us felt disappointment when we heard the news. At her farewell lunch, we gave her a card to show our appreciation. Honestly, it was a terrific party. Nora even made a short apology for leaving so suddenly. Some of us are still cautious about the new team leader, but he seems nice.
items.passageZh: 上星期，我們的組長 Nora 在待了十年之後離開了公司。她一直都很忠誠又努力。但她也很有抱負，所以接下了新加坡的一份新工作。我們很多人聽到消息時都很失望。在她的歡送午餐上，我們送她一張卡片表達感謝。老實說，那是一場很棒的派對。Nora 甚至為自己這麼突然離開而簡短地道歉。我們有些人對新組長還是有點保留，但他看起來人不錯。

options: 她想先休息一年去旅行

questions.questionZh: 同事們送了 Nora 什麼？

referenceEn: This result was a big disappointment to me.
The result was a disappointment for me.
rubricZh: disappointment 是名詞「失望；令人失望的事」，前面可加 a big 等
例如 a disappointment to／for me 等說法
寫 I was very disappointed with the result. 也正確

items.promptZh: 老實說，我不記得他的名字了。
referenceEn: Honestly, I don't remember his name.
I honestly can't remember his name.
rubricZh: 用 honestly 表示「老實說」（例如 Honestly, I…、I honestly… 等，位置不限）
「不記得」可寫，例如 don't remember、can't remember 等
